title: englerodendron conchyliophorum
intro: Englerodendron conchyliophorum, commonly known as the Red-barked tree, is a plant species belonging to the Apocynaceae family. This plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, with reported health benefits including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant effects. The therapeutic actions of Englerodendron conchyliophorum may include wound healing, pain relief, and the treatment of various infections. The bioactive constituents of this plant have been identified as alkaloids, flavonoids, and phenolic compounds, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
